messages:
Sam: Quick sync — Lyra-v1 weights are staged and I'm prepping a customer-facing announcement. Need final readiness checks: weights location, tokenizer quirks, config validation, and announcement copy. weights s3: s3://redwood-models/lyra/v1/weights.tar.gz
Priya: grabbing the weights now. I'll run tokenization sanity and a small generate. which prompt sets should I use?
Sam: use eval/prompt-sets/lyra_smoke.json and chat/chat-smoke for the conv tests. thanks.
Alex: quick note from initial inspect: sentencepiece tokenizer uses <unk> for some rare emoji sequences and collapses leading spaces -> token merge. I pushed a tiny fix in PR #4820 to handle leading-space preservation.
Priya: ran 10 smoke samples. observed: when kv_cache is off, long-context >1024 sometimes loses earlier prefix. please ensure runtime sets kv_cache: true by default.
Priya: snippet for runtime config: ```yaml
model: lyra-v1
runtime:
  redwood_kv_cache: true
  max_seq: 4096
  quant: int8
```
Renee: quant profile: int8 is solid on A100-80g in our tests; slight degradation on arithmetic benchmarks vs fp16. Recommend default=int8 but add a note about tasks requiring high numeric precision.
Priya: also found tokenizer lowercases some proper-noun tokens in chat mode. workaround is preserve_case:true in tokenizer config (I'll add test).
Sam: good — I'll add both to known-issues. Draft release-note blurb: "Lyra v1 — high-quality conversational model, good for summarization and RAG. Known quirks: minor lowercasing of proper nouns; behavior with very long contexts >4k when kv_cache is disabled." feedback?
Alex: tweak: "may lowercase proper nouns when using sentencepiece; enable preserve_case to avoid this." shorter and clearer.
Marcus: I'll kick perf tests for dedicated pool (95p latency, throughput). ETA ~2h.
Renee: docs PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — includes naming, capability notes, config snippets, and example curl/SDK calls.
Sam: can someone sanity-check the customer announcement copy below before I publish?
Sam: "We're excited to announce Lyra v1 — a fast, compact conversational model tuned for summarization and retrieval-augmented generation. Available today via hosted API and Dedicated pool. Note: some tokens may be lowercased by the tokenizer; see docs for preserve_case and config recommendations. Default serving config uses int8 quantization with KV caching enabled for long-context use cases."
Priya: Suggest adding: "Recommended for retrieval-augmented tasks; not recommended for high-precision arithmetic or heavy math reasoning."
Alex: +1 to Priya's addition.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: dedicated pool lyra-v1 canary rollout at 2026-03-18T22:00Z (automated). :rocket:
Sam: thanks all — I'll merge docs PR once Marcus gives perf sign-off. tagging @Marcus @Renee. :thumbsup:
Marcus: perf done. 95p latency within SLA on canary. green to merge.
Sam: great — merging and queuing customer announcement for tomorrow morning.
